name: core
title: Core
description: Request context, logging, error reporting, analytics, security headers and the UI shell. Always on.

APP_URL.description: Public origin of the app, e.g. https://app.example.com

LOG_LEVEL.description: Lowest level written to the logs: Debug, Info, Warn or Error

ERROR_REPORTER.description: Where errors go: none, console or sentry

ANALYTICS_PROVIDER.description: Where analytics events go: none, console, posthog or analytics-engine

SENTRY_DSN.description: Sentry DSN, used when ERROR_REPORTER is sentry

POSTHOG_KEY.description: PostHog project API key, used when ANALYTICS_PROVIDER is posthog
